semantics.definition: The menu icon that turns into a close icon: three lines while the menu is shut, a cross while it is open.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one menu icon every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Let one button open and close a menu.

state.open: a cross: the outer lines turned to meet, the middle one gone
